international.title: Hannah Lillith Assadi wins National book award for ‘visionary’ novel Paradiso 17
international.summary: Assadi’s third novel was inspired by the story of her late father, a Palestinian who escaped the Nakba as a child in 1948 Palestinian-Jewish author Hannah Lillith Assadi has won the National book award for fiction, one of the US’s most prestigious literary prizes, for her novel Paradiso 17. Assadi’s third novel is a study of the psychic toll of displacement on migrants, through the tale of a Palestinian man who escaped the Nakba in 1948, when more than 700,000 Palestinians fled or were expelled from their homes by Israel. The story was inspired by her father, Sami Abdul-Fattah Al-Assadi, who fled the Nakba as a child with his family, before studying in Italy and moving to New York. Continue reading...
